subject: Conversion dashboard check
message: I'm Maya Chen on the Analytics team. Use IT-021 for this request, submitted October 22, 2026. Could you help by setting up read-only access to the staging instance of Atlas for the first time, from October 23 through November 6, 2026? I need to check the weekly conversion dashboard with the new event definition changes before the next reporting cycle. My manager is Priya Shah.
